title: Q137(m) blind pool 4
written_by: an independent designer who never saw the model
format: 2,048 bytes a tile: raw A (1,024 B) then raw B (1,024 B), in the type's layout (make_kinds.encode); stats from make_kinds.tile_stats

tiles.name: fp32.cancel_pairs
tiles.rule: randn; A[i][2m+1] = A[i][2m] and B[2m+1][j] = -B[2m][j], so every k-pair adds exactly zero to C

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.sign_drift
tiles.rule: abs(randn) with one random sign s_k per k shared by A column k and B line k: every product positive, C only grows

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.wideexp_bgate_alt
tiles.rule: random sign, exponent 2^-120..2^120, random mantissa; B columns 8-15 all +0.0, so every lane alternates a wide-exponent word with zero each cycle (half the slots gated)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.wideexp_agate_rows
tiles.rule: wide-exponent words (2^-120..2^120) both sides; A rows 2,5,8,11,14 all zero (whole micro-ops gated) and 20% of B words zero at random

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.denormals_only
tiles.rule: every word an fp32 subnormal: exponent field 0, random nonzero 23-bit mantissa, random sign; no word is zero so nothing gates, but a flush-to-zero datapath sees only zeros

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.a_const_b_busy
tiles.rule: A every element 1.5 (0x3FC00000, A never changes), B standard normal

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.a_exp_busy_b_const
tiles.rule: A = random sign * 2^U{-60..60}, mantissa 0 (only sign and exponent fields move); B every element 0.75

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.b_3of8_k
tiles.rule: A randn dense; B randn with N:M sparsity 3:8 along k: in each column, 3 of every 8 k-lines nonzero (62.5% of B words zero)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.rowcol_sparse
tiles.rule: randn; A rows 1,4,7,10,13 zero (31.25%); B columns 2 and 10 zero (lane 2 gated on both half-passes) and column 5 zero (its partner 13 is not)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.real_pythia_embed_qkv
tiles.rule: pythia-70m: A = token embeddings (rows 100-115, dims 0-15), B = layer-2 query_key_value weight W[0:16, 0:16] transposed (head 0's query rows); fp16 source values, exact in fp32

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp32.real_qwen_q_down
tiles.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B: A = layer-12 q_proj weight rows 128-143, cols 0-15; B = layer-0 mlp.down_proj W[0:16, 2048:2064] transposed; bf16 source values, exact in fp32 (low 16 mantissa bits zero)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.pair_cancel
tiles.rule: randn; both halves of every A word equal (a1 = a2) and B[2w+1][j] = -B[2w][j]: every two-term update a1*b1 + a2*b2 is exactly zero, yet no lane gates and no update is dropped

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.wideexp_gate30
tiles.rule: fp16 bit patterns: random sign, exponent field uniform 1..30 (2^-14..2^15) with 10% subnormals, random mantissa; 30% of the 32-bit words zeroed on each side

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.a_hi_busy_lo_const
tiles.rule: A: even k (the low half of each word) = 1.0, odd k (the high half) randn; B randn

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.block_sparse_37
tiles.rule: randn; the 16x16 word grid in 4x4-word blocks: 6 of B's 16 blocks zero (37.5%), 3 of A's (18.75%)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.band_local
tiles.rule: randn; A word (i, w) nonzero only where abs(i - w) <= 1 (46 of 256), B word (p, j) only where abs(p - j) <= 3 (100 of 256): local-attention bands on both sides

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.real_pythia_embed_qkv
tiles.rule: pythia-70m: A = token embeddings rows 200-215, dims 64-95; B = layer-2 query_key_value W[512:528, 64:96] transposed (GPT-NeoX interleaves q,k,v per head: these are head 2's value rows); fp16 source values, stored exactly

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: fp16.real_qwen_ln_down
tiles.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B: A = layer-12 input_layernorm gains 0-511 laid out 16x32 (values near 1, a few up to 6.7); B = layer-0 mlp.down_proj W[400:416, 300:332] transposed; bf16 rounded to fp16 (nearest-even)

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')

tiles.name: int8.sign_runs_i
tiles.rule: magnitudes 1..20 (abs(round(6*randn)), zeros bumped to 1); A sign constant down each A column for runs of 8 rows (i 0-7, 8-15), random per run and k; B uniform -128..127

seed.rng: numpy default_rng([base, tag]), tag = first 8 bytes (LE) of sha256('blind4/<name>')
